title: Formation of Large Clusters in the Reaction of Lanthanide Cations with Heptamolybdate

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Lanthanum heptamolybdate cluster, mixed tetramethylammonium–ammonium salt

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve ammonium heptamolybdate tetrahydrate in water and add methanol. Add an aqueous solution of lanthanum nitrate hexahydrate dropwise with stirring at room temperature, followed by aqueous tetramethylammonium bromide solution. Keep the closed vessel at room temperature for 48 h.
solvents: Water (20 mL plus 5 mL for lanthanum solution)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Closed reaction vessel; dropwise addition with stirring
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless single crystals formed from the solution.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete tetranuclear lanthanide core contains a central tetrahedral molybdate unit and 16 coordinated water molecules. Four heptamolybdate groups surround and link the four nine-coordinate lanthanide centers.

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve ammonium heptamolybdate tetrahydrate in water and add methanol. Add an aqueous solution of cerium chloride heptahydrate dropwise with stirring at room temperature. Keep the resulting solution in a closed flask at 278 K for 18 h.
solvents: Water (9 mL plus 5 mL for cerium solution)
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature during addition; 278 K during crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Closed reaction flask; dropwise addition with stirring
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Red single crystals formed from the solution.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete [Ce4(MoO4)(H2O)16(Mo7O24)4]14− anion has four nine-coordinate cerium centers around a central tetrahedral molybdate unit, with four surrounding heptamolybdate groups.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the procedure for compound 2, replacing cerium chloride heptahydrate with praseodymium nitrate pentahydrate: add its aqueous solution dropwise to ammonium heptamolybdate tetrahydrate in water and methanol, then keep the closed flask at 278 K for 18 h.
solvents: Water (9 mL plus 5 mL for praseodymium solution; procedure for 2)
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature during addition; 278 K during crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Closed reaction flask; dropwise addition with stirring as for 2
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Green single crystals formed from the solution.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete [Pr4(MoO4)(H2O)16(Mo7O24)4]14− anion has a tetranuclear praseodymium core containing a central molybdate unit and surrounded by four heptamolybdate groups.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Samarium heptamolybdate cluster, mixed tetramethylammonium–ammonium salt

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve ammonium heptamolybdate tetrahydrate in water and add methanol. Add aqueous samarium nitrate hexahydrate dropwise with stirring at room temperature, followed by aqueous tetramethylammonium bromide solution. Keep the closed flask at 278 K for 24 h.
solvents: Water (20 mL plus 5 mL for samarium solution)
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature during addition; 278 K during crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Closed reaction flask; dropwise addition with stirring
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Light-yellow single crystals formed from the solution.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete [Sm4(MoO4)(H2O)16(Mo7O24)4]14− anion has a tetranuclear samarium core containing a central molybdate unit and surrounded by four heptamolybdate groups.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Gadolinium heptamolybdate cluster, mixed tetramethylammonium–ammonium salt

synthesis.procedure: Prepared similarly to compound 1, replacing lanthanum nitrate hexahydrate with gadolinium nitrate pentahydrate. Add the aqueous gadolinium solution to ammonium heptamolybdate tetrahydrate in water and methanol, add aqueous tetramethylammonium bromide, and keep the vessel closed at room temperature.

solvents: Water (20 mL plus 5 mL for gadolinium solution; procedure for 1)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Closed reaction vessel; procedure analogous to 1
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless single crystals formed from the solution.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete [Gd4(MoO4)(H2O)16(Mo7O24)4]14− anion has a tetranuclear gadolinium core containing a central molybdate unit and surrounded by four heptamolybdate groups.
